sections.title: Top Navigation & Quick Actions
sections.purpose: Provide global status and key actions like 'Elderly Mode' toggle and 'Sync to Cloud' button.

sections.title: Real-time Health Overview
sections.purpose: Display current vital signs (heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep, activity) at a glance.

sections.title: AI Insights & Risk Warnings
sections.purpose: Show AI-generated health analysis, alerts, and professional reports.

sections.title: Personalized Improvement Plans
sections.purpose: Provide actionable advice (sleep improvement, exercise, diet).

user_flows: User toggles 'Elderly Mode' -> Dashboard layout simplifies, font size increases, contrasts become higher.
User clicks 'Sync to Huawei Cloud' -> Loading animation triggers, data updates, success toast appears.
User clicks on a specific vital sign card -> Expands to show detailed historical trend chart.
responsive_priorities: Mobile layout stacks vital cards vertically.
Elderly mode prioritizes touch target size and reduces information density on all screen sizes.
